Today’s failing approach: a separate diagram tool for the design round
Challenge 1:
Design and code in separate tools
When the design discussion runs in a diagram tool, the coding usually happens in another tool or a second interview. The second session adds interviewer hours to each senior hire. The interviewer who heard the design often does not see the candidate build any part of it.
Challenge 2:
Different standards for each interviewer
Without shared criteria for the design round, two interviewers can score the same architecture at different levels. The hiring committee then has to reconcile two different opinions.
Challenge 3:
Only notes after the round
After the round, the sketch stays in the diagram tool, separate from each interviewer’s notes. The hiring committee compares those notes with no shared record.
Run the system design round in Codility Interview
Codility Interview is a live technical interview platform for engineering teams. Your team brings the design tasks it already uses for senior and backend roles. Codility provides the environment and the session record.

Questions about system design interview tools
A system design interview tool is software for running a technical interview’s system design round on a shared whiteboard. Codility Interview is a system design interview tool with a whiteboard and a VS Code workspace in the same session.
Excalidraw runs inside the interview as the shared whiteboard. Candidates do not need an account to join the canvas.
Give the candidate a realistic design task and score it against criteria your interviewers agree on before the round. Ask the candidate to explain each design decision and the alternatives they rejected. Score the reasoning behind the diagram, including requirements, data model, failure handling and trade-offs.
